NOTE: thread ORDER in this fixture is deliberate and load-bearing. The non-pool
threads at the BOTTOM must stay BELOW the pool block. The predicate arms itself on a
pool-thread header and disarms on the very next line, so a lock-contention line that
appears BEFORE the first pool header is invisible to a predicate that forgets to
disarm — move these blocks up and this fixture still passes while testing nothing.
It exists to prove the count ignores lock contention on threads outside the RPC pool
(a healthy engine has some at almost any instant), so this file must count 0.
